title: Peripheral Vestibular Organs: Semicircular Canals and Otoliths
author: Christian Pfeiffer, Andrea Serino, and Olaf Blanke
caption: Diagram of the peripheral vestibular sensory organs including the semicircular canals (angular acceleration) and utricle/saccule otolith organs (linear acceleration and gravity).
alt_text: Diagram showing semicircular canals, utricle, saccule, and vestibular hair cells.
clinical_relevance: Explains otolith unloading in microgravity and canal-otolith sensory mismatch underlying Space Adaptation Syndrome (CLIFF-064, p.1, p.6).
topic_region: Inner Ear / Otolith Organs & Semicircular Canals
